shared_elements: a creature/animal form with a prominent head
curvilinear scroll or curl motifs (A) vs. patterned border (B) — both include some decorative infill
justification: Both surfaces carry relief imagery including at least one animate creature with an emphasized head, but that is a wholly generic correspondence. A shows a single dense, frontal, scroll-laden zoomorphic/anthropomorphic mass filling an irregular field, while B shows a horizontal file of profile human figures carrying vessels beside a led camel, framed above and below by rosette bands — different subjects, relationships and compositional schemes entirely.
